_comment: C0-12 bedrock-agents bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（microsoft-agent-framework），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: Each vendor's models are reached via Bedrock (Anthropic Claude, Meta, Mistral, Amazon's own etc. — per the Bedrock model catalog framing); the specific list has not been verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Cloud-hosted: agents run on AWS (two lines: Agents orchestration + AgentCore runtime); no self-hosted form. The old product URL bedrock/agent/ now 404s (direct-fetched & verified 2026-10-21); current entries are bedrock/agents/ and bedrock/agentcore/.
axes.local_files: Knowledge bases connect to S3, vector stores and other in-AWS resources — the file surface is entirely in the cloud; it hosts no local-file runtime — the "AI reads/writes local files" form does not exist here (recorded honestly, not "officially not allowed").
axes.background: Cloud-hosted and resident; AgentCore pitches a "managed runtime for any framework" (official narrative; details not verified item by item).
axes.tools: Official action groups/gateway + MCP support (the Bedrock docs line includes MCP entries; details not verified item by item).
axes.context: Session state and Knowledge Bases retrieval are the official context surface; cross-session memory not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: IAM/resource policies follow the AWS system — enterprise governance is a native AWS strength.
axes.fit: Fits: AWS-installed enterprises, IAM-grade governance, a "framework-agnostic managed runtime" (AgentCore). Does not fit: outside the AWS ecosystem; self-hosting.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- Feature overlap and division between Agents and AgentCore (the official narrative is evolving; not verified item by item)
- MCP support details (docs-line entries exist but not verified item by item)
- The current Bedrock model catalog
related: Cloud-giant contrast: Microsoft open-sources its framework (MAF), AWS pushes a managed platform — two routes.
